description.value: Springfield Bulk Foods is a locally owned, three-generation bulk food store occupying unit 133 of a Springfield Road shopping centre in Kelowna. It stocks a wide range of dry goods sold by weight — flours, rices, sugars, beans and lentils, nuts, dried fruits, pasta, seasonings, and specialty items like multiple quinoa varieties and organic grains. For a touring cyclist resupplying calories, the bulk-format shopping makes it easy to buy exactly the quantity needed.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is active and confirms the business name, address (133-1889 Springfield Rd, Kelowna, BC V1Y 5V5), and phone (250-860-4585) matching OSM. The site clearly identifies this as a locally owned bulk food store carrying flours, grains, nuts, dried fruits, pasta, and spices — confirming the Groceries category. No website or OSM evidence exists for bike parking, water refill, washrooms, or any other cyclist-specific infrastructure, so those remain null. One minor concern: the front-page header shows postal code V1Y 2R8 while the footer, contact page, and OSM all show V1Y 5V5.
concerns: Postal code inconsistency on website: front-page header shows V1Y 2R8 while the footer, contact page, and OSM all show V1Y 5V5. V1Y 5V5 is likely correct.
OSM tags the shop as 'supermarket' but it is a specialty bulk food store, not a full-service supermarket — category Groceries is still appropriate.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, actively operating locally owned bulk food store with a current website and confirmed contact details — a practical resupply stop for touring cyclists.
